title: Surjectivity of Reduction Maps for Special Polynomial Automorphisms
statement: For a commutative ring $R$ containing $\mathbb{Q}$, $m\geq1$, and $Y=(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$, is the reduction map $\operatorname{SAut}_{R[t]}(R[t][Y])\to\operatorname{SAut}_{R[t]/(t^m)}(R[t]/(t^m)[Y])$ surjective, where $\operatorname{SAut}$ denotes polynomial automorphisms with Jacobian determinant $1$?
